update.releaseNotes:
v5.9.69 - Wire up Decision Report and Debug Images viewer UI
Added ----- - Calendar cells in the Remote Log Viewer are now clickable for any turn with a decision (race, train, or rest), opening a modal with the full Decision Report text.
Changed ------- - The Debug Images tab now loads images via the lightweight /debug-images REST API instead of streaming them over the WebSocket connection, with real download links for each image.
